Marcus (AE): FieldGuide sent RFI + POC ask. 2-week POC on Hosted, option to switch to Dedicated, EU-only residency, KMS required, and pricing at ~2M tokens/mo. Can we assemble RFI one-pager and SOW?
Olivia (SE): Please attach RFI PDF and prompt_set. I'll run a quick token profile.
Marcus (AE): Drive links: https://drive.redwood/fieldguide/rfi.pdf and /prompt_set.json. They also asked about model fallback if capacity constrained.
Tara (Solutions Eng): Yes — routing policy supports tiered fallback (primary -> quantized -> open fallback). Note parity risk. For POC propose 4x A10G, quantized model, KV cache on.
Ryan (Pricing): Ballpark hosted cost: $0.01/1k -> ~$20k/mo. Dedicated (3mo commit) ~ $12k/mo. EU residency + extended audit = +30% uplift.
sec-bot: SECURITY CHECK: FieldGuide wants EU-only data, customer KMS, 1yr audit retention. Default audit = 90d, enterprise add-on to 12mo. I'll post checklist link.
Tara (Solutions Eng): Action items: Olivia -> eval CSV by EOD; Ryan -> pricing table; I'll draft 1-page capability matrix + 2-week SOW by tomorrow morning.
Marcus (AE): Great. I'll package and send RFI. Ping if blockers.
